title: rules.decision-log.masked-input-searched.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction of every POST /decisions:find-by-masked-input (RLE-012), including one refused because the caller is past masking.search.max-per-minute: the audit entry of a personal-data lookup. It names who searched which input of which rule set over which period and how many decisions were found. It never carries the searched value or its fingerprint. The outbox row id is the event id. Carries the full event envelope. Additive changes only within v1.

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the search ran, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id (X-Correlation-Id, or the one passed to the Java API). When the caller gave none, the event id: the event starts its own chain.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

outcome.description: SEARCHED when the search ran; RATE_LIMITED when it was refused with 429 because the caller is past masking.search.max-per-minute (matches is then 0).

from.description: Start of the period, inclusive, ISO 8601 UTC.

to.description: End of the period, exclusive, ISO 8601 UTC.

truncated.description: True when more decisions matched than the limit.

keyIds.description: Ids of the keys the value was fingerprinted with, the current key first. Never the keys.
